Subject: Let's Wrassle apparel for SHWA wrestlers
Body:
Hi Coach Kocher,

I'm Nate Smith, founder of Let's Wrassle Apparel Co. here in Pittsburgh. I was a 2x All-American at Pitt-Johnstown under Coach Pecora, and I've followed what you've built at SHWA. It's one of the best rooms in the South Hills.

I make premium tees, crewnecks and socks for wrestlers and their families, in youth and adult sizes: letswrassleapparel.com

I'd love to get Let's Wrassle into SHWA. Two ways it could work:

- Stock a small selection at the academy at wholesale (50% off retail: tees $12.50, crewnecks $16, socks $8) and keep the margin. Opening orders start small.
- A co-branded SHWA x Let's Wrassle shirt, like the collab I did with Silent Victory Training Center. It's a good fundraiser for the club.

I can drop off a sample shirt this week so you can see the quality. Would you be open to a quick chat?

If this isn't a fit, just reply and I won't follow up.

Thanks,
Nate
Notes: Pitt All-American running a big South Hills room. Pitt connection.
